heading: Export
hint: Every format is built here, in this tab. Nothing is uploaded to make a file.

formats.qasm3: The interchange format. Qiskit and most hardware toolchains read it; a gate with no equivalent there is written out as an exact decomposition, with a comment saying so.
formats.qiskit: Python for a notebook, with the imports, the registers and a comment naming where it came from.
formats.json: The native format. The only export that loses nothing, and the one to keep if you want to open this circuit here again.
formats.svg: The diagram as a vector graphic. Self-contained: it carries its own colours and asks for no typeface it does not have — and it carries this circuit inside it, so it can be imported back here.
formats.png: The diagram as an image, drawn at twice its size on screen so it stays sharp in a slide or an issue.

failure.too-large: This circuit is too wide to turn into an image. The SVG export has no such limit.
failure.unknown: That file could not be created.
